schema.description:
GetWorkspaceInfoResponse carries workspace-level capabilities the UI uses to
tailor what it shows.

canManageNetworkPolicy.description:
Whether the caller may change the workspace network policy (org
permission "manage_workspace_settings": workspace owners, managers and
custom roles with the "Modify workspace settings" bundle). Everyone else
sees the policy read-only; UpdateWorkspaceNetworkPolicy enforces the same
permission server-side.

canTerminateAnySession.description:
True when the caller may terminate any session in the workspace, whoever
owns it: the 'rde-admin-terminate-any-session' rollout flag is on for the
workspace and the caller holds the org permission "view_billing_data"
(the people who can view usage). Drives the per-session lists and their
Terminate actions on the usage page; TerminateSession re-checks both
server-side.

canViewUsage.description:
Whether the caller may see the workspace usage page (org permission
"view_billing_data" — workspace owners and billing-managing custom
roles). Gates the Usage navigation item in the UI; GetWorkspaceUsage
enforces the same permission server-side.

isFreeTrial.description:
Whether the workspace is on a free trial. Free-trial sessions are pinned to
an 8-hour auto-terminate window that cannot be changed.

lifecycleHooksEnabled.description:
Whether lifecycle hooks are enabled for this workspace (rollout feature
flag 'rde-lifecycle-hooks', docs/lifecycle-hooks/DESIGN.md). Gates
saving templates with hooks and decides how new sessions start: with
the flag on, new sessions run their hooks through the RDE runner (legacy
templates through a fixed mapping); with it off, they start exactly as
before. Sessions already running on the runner keep working either way.

networkPolicyEnabled.description:
Whether workspace network policies are enabled for this workspace
(rollout feature flag 'rde-network-gateway'). Gates the Network policy
navigation item and the network policy endpoints; turning the flag
off is the kill switch that stops applying policies to sessions.

warmPoolsEnabled.description:
Whether warm pools are enabled for this workspace (rollout feature flag
'rde-warm-pool'). Gates the Warm pools navigation item, the template
actions that create a pool, and CreateWarmPool server-side; pools that
already exist stay manageable and claimable regardless.

workspaceScriptAvailable.description:
True when the 'rde-workspace-script' rollout flag is on for this
workspace, whoever the caller: sessions may then run the workspace
script, so the UI offers the log views its output lands in. Unlike
workspace_script_enabled it says nothing about editing the script.

workspaceScriptEnabled.description:
True when the workspace script is available to this caller: the
'rde-workspace-script' rollout flag is on and the caller may edit it
(the same people who can view usage). Drives the Workspace script nav
item; the endpoints re-check server-side.
